title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. to Host a Live Webcast for Existing Shareholders Discussing the Company’s Recent Announcements and Potential Listing on the NYSE
summary: Webcast to Be Held Thursday, October 7, 2021, at 2:30 p.m. CST InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust”, “IVT” or the “Company”) plans to host a live webcast for existing shareholders on Thursday, October 7, 2021 at 2:30 p.m. Central Time to discuss the proposed listing of its stock on the New York Stock Exchange and other company announcements. Date: Thursday, October 7, 2021 Time: 2:30 p.m. Central Time Webcast link: https://services.choruscall.com/links/iare211007.html The accompanying presentation can be accessed by visiting https://www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/financials/presentations/ . About InvenTrust Properties Corp. InvenTrust Properties Corp. (IVT) is a premier Sun Belt multi-tenant essential retail REIT that owns, leases, redevelops, acquires and manages grocery-anchored neighborhood and community centers as well as high-quality power centers.
